title: Make Polli more concise and independent
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
Polli was too willing to follow oversized requests and return long replies.

This makes it use its own judgment, prefer short answers, refuse bulk Discord transcripts, choose an explicit `top_n` for searches, and use display names naturally while keeping usernames available for tools.

Tested with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

gist.headline: Polli grew a backbone
gist.blurb: Polli now knows when a request is too big for one tidy reply. She brings shorter answers, sensible search limits, and a polite no to bulk Discord transcript hauling.
gist.summary: Updated the Polli app to favor concise independent answers, refuse bulk Discord transcript requests, require an explicit top_n for searches, and use display names naturally while retaining usernames for tools.
gist.impact: Polli users get shorter, more deliberate responses and focused Discord search results instead of oversized transcript dumps.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a thoughtful little librarian bee in a cozy Discord-inspired garden study, wearing tiny reading glasses and choosing a small neat stack of message scrolls labeled top_n while gently setting an enormous transcript pile aside. Include a retro terminal, code-plants, and a few friendly flowers to show careful tool use and concise judgment.
